Today's featured picture on the English #Wikipedia is Willa Beatrice Player (August 9, 1909 – August 29, 2003) was an American educator, college administrator, college president, civil-rights activist, and federal appointee.

Player was the first African-American woman to become president of a four-year, fully accredited liberal arts college when she took the position at Bennett College in Greensboro, North Carolina.

➡️ More information: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Willa_Beatrice_Player
